name: Touhou Inma Gou ~Hajimete no Danmaku~
original_name: 東方淫魔郷 ～はじめてのだんまく～
source:
A red demon lives in a mansion somewhere in the Lost paradise. There is a vampire sister next to him, feared by all youkai. They pull the threads so that dolls dance in accordance to their will. But the dolls are actually humans in the real world. These are six stories showing the outcomes of demon manipulation.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
失乐园某处的宅邸里住着一名红色恶魔。他身旁有一个令所有妖怪都畏惧的吸血鬼妹妹。他们牵动丝线，让玩偶按照自己的意志起舞。但那些玩偶其实是现实世界中的人类。这是六个故事，展现恶魔操纵的结果。

[译自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/08/vn-of-month-august-2004-sorauta.html]VNDB Review[/url]]
